verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes separate Postman collections for each API version (gusto-docs-68). A Postman collection is a first-party, machine-readable API description that can reasonably count as an "equivalent" format, though it is weaker than an OpenAPI spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation rather than an API spec, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: an explicit downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, evidence the collections include full request/response schemas, a documented download location, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
